sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def slot(f,r0,c0):
    lines=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if lines[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def allslots(f):
    out={}
    for j,c0 in enumerate((15,22,29,36,43)):
        out[('B',j)]=slot(f,41,c0)
        out[('P',j)]=slot(f,52,c0)
    return out
def markerpos(f):
    lines=f.ascii.split('\n')
    # white U markers: check rows 47-48 and 58-59 for 'W'
    for r in (47,58):
        for c in range(14,48):
            if lines[r][c]=='W':
                return (r,c)
    return None
print("marker:",markerpos(current_frame))
base=allslots(current_frame)
# move marker to each position, press UP, see what changes
# currently marker at pos1 (col 22). Move RIGHT to pos4, test; then LEFT through all
pos=1
for target in (2,3,4):
    action(['RIGHT']); pos+=1
    before=allslots(current_frame)
    action(['UP'])
    after=allslots(current_frame)
    ch=[k for k in after if after[k]!=before[k]]
    print("pos",pos,"UP changes:",ch)
for target in (3,2,1,0):
    action(['LEFT']); pos-=1
    before=allslots(current_frame)
    action(['UP'])
    after=allslots(current_frame)
    ch=[k for k in after if after[k]!=before[k]]
    print("pos",pos,"UP changes:",ch)
print("marker now:",markerpos(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
